cases.given: Generation can run in parallel, but source review and schema validation can become bottlenecks.
cases.expect: Steady validated output without queue or review collapse.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the task is one atomic operation
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Mandatory serial dependencies and vetoes override concurrency goals.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A workflow has an adequate total budget and depth plan but generation outpaces validation.
cases.expect: The skill adjusts work in progress, batching, concurrency, and backpressure using completion and rework signals.
cases.reject: The skill merely lowers total reasoning budget or reallocates depth among task regions.
